name: shimmer-lines
title: Shimmer Lines
description: Text that shimmers as a band of light sweeps across its glyphs, then rests; longer lines sweep for longer. Wraps any text, in classic, aurora or flame.
label: Text Shimmer Lines (CodePen)

source.path: debug view: the main p rule and its shimmer keyframes

author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>

props.name: variant
props.description: The band: one color, a multi-color aurora, or a flame.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds per character of text; the sweep takes longer on longer lines.

props.name: duration
props.description: A fixed duration in seconds, instead of one derived from the text.

props.name: length
props.description: The character count the duration is derived from; defaults to the length of the text in children. Pass it for text you edit in place.

props.name: spread
props.description: Half the band's width, in ch.

props.name: angle
props.description: The band's angle in degrees (mirrored in right-to-left).

props.name: position
props.description: Holds the band at this position, 0 to 100, without animating.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the animation on its current frame.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root (an inline-block span).

a11y: The text stays real text: selectable, searchable and read by screen readers as it is; only its color is painted by the gradient.
Reduced motion: no band and no animation, the text shows in the full-contrast highlight color.
The resting color is a faint gray (it fails 4.5:1 by design, like the original). Under prefers-contrast: more it becomes the highlight color, and under forced colors the system text color.
Right to left: the band sweeps from the inline start edge with its slant mirrored; left to right is unchanged.
paused holds the band for people who need the animation stopped (WCAG 2.2.2).
